portInfo.description: Chios mixes an urban harbour with an island hinterland shaped by mastic cultivation and medieval fortified villages. A town call can focus on the castle and museum quarter; Pyrgi, Mesta and Nea Moni require deliberate road time. Do not let a compact island outline turn those into adjacent old-town streets.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Castle of Chios, Castle of Chios, Chios town: An inhabited fortified quarter, not just an isolated ruin. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Keep to public streets; individual monuments may have separate entry.

Byzantine Museum at Mecidiye Cami, Vounaki Square, Chios 82100: A named town-centre museum building with Byzantine-to-modern material. Allow about 75 minutes (editorial estimate). Opening/fees on the undated regional listing need a current venue check.

Chios Municipal Art Gallery, 1 Andreas Syggros Street, Chios 82100: A compact art stop with a source-backed street address. Allow about 60 minutes (editorial estimate). Confirm current exhibition and public hours.

Pyrgi medieval village, Pyrgi village centre, Chios: A focused southern-village visit within the mastic-country defensive network. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Driver pickup at the agreed village-edge point; not a port-side walk.

Mesta medieval village, Mesta village centre, Chios: An inhabited fortified village distinct from Mesta’s cruise harbour. Allow about 90 minutes (editorial estimate). Narrow lanes; confirm accessible route and a specific vehicle meeting point.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Write the port name and town/landing in the driver agreement. Mesta VILLAGE and Mesta PORT are also different meeting places; do not use the name alone for your return pickup.
